## Diferentes muestras, resultados diferentes

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 4.6
#| fig-align: center

set.seed(42)
# Población: ganancia de peso bovina (kg/animal), Normal(5.2, 0.8^2)
mu_real <- 5.2; sigma_real <- 0.8; N_pop <- 10000; n <- 30

pop <- rnorm(N_pop, mu_real, sigma_real)

# 25 muestras distintas
medias <- replicate(25, mean(sample(pop, n)))

par(mar = c(4.5, 4.5, 3, 1), family = "sans")

plot(seq_along(medias), medias,
     pch = 19, cex = 1.4,
     col = ifelse(abs(medias - mu_real) < 0.3, "#1e3a8a", "#dc2626"),
     ylim = c(mu_real - 1.2, mu_real + 1.2),
     xlab = "Número de muestra",
     ylab = "Media muestral (kg/animal)",
     main = "25 muestras distintas del mismo lote (n = 30 corrales cada una)",
     cex.main = 1.2, cex.lab = 1.1, cex.axis = 1.05)

abline(h = mu_real, col = "#15803d", lwd = 2.5, lty = 2)
abline(h = c(mu_real - sigma_real/sqrt(n)*1.96,
             mu_real + sigma_real/sqrt(n)*1.96),
       col = "#f59e0b", lwd = 1.5, lty = 3)

text(26, mu_real + 0.07, labels = expression(mu == 5.2),
     col = "#15803d", cex = 1.1, pos = 2, font = 2)
text(26, mu_real + sigma_real/sqrt(n)*1.96 + 0.07,
     labels = "IC 95%", col = "#f59e0b", cex = 0.95, pos = 2)

legend("bottomright",
       legend = c("Media muestral", "Media real μ = 5.2", "IC 95% esperado"),
       col    = c("#1e3a8a", "#15803d", "#f59e0b"),
       pch    = c(19, NA, NA), lty = c(NA, 2, 3), lwd = c(NA, 2.5, 1.5),
       pt.cex = 1.2, bty = "n", cex = 1)

box(col = "gray40")
```
